scale.source: DGII 'Escala retencion asalariados 2025' (archived 2025-06-22): 'Rentas desde RD$867,123.01 en adelante' 25 % (start of the top band of Codigo Tributario art. 296 as indexed)
scale.basis: DGII 'Escala retencion asalariados 2025' (archived 2025-06-22): 'Rentas desde RD$867,123.01 en adelante' 25 % (start of the top band of Codigo Tributario art. 296 as indexed). A statutory amount, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Codigo Tributario (Ley 11-92)' confirmed: art. 296 progressive scale indexed by inflation (art. 327); DGII 2025 table exempt to 416,220, 15 % to 624,329, 20 % to 867,123, 25 % above; SDSS employee 3.04 % (SFS) + 2.87 % (AFP), caps 10 and 20 minimum wages.
